if element("materialId"):GetInt()~=0 then game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgMaterialInformationRequest(element:GetReceiver(), element("materialId"):GetInt()) ) element:DoStoredScript("enableMe") else element:DoStoredScript("disableMe") end

local s = ""
if element("numCollected"):GetInt() >= 0 then s = "+" else --[[ element["MaterialAmount"]["Text"]("red"):SetFloat(1.0) element["MaterialAmount"]["Text"]("green"):SetFloat(0) element["MaterialAmount"]["Text"]("blue"):SetFloat(0) ]]
end
s = s .. element("numCollected"):GetInt()
element["MaterialAmount"]["Text"]("text"):SetString(s)

local materialId = msg.materialId; if materialId == element("materialId"):GetInt() then element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("spriteName"):SetString(msg.imageID .. "") element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/" .. msg.spriteSheetID) element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("layer"):SetString("PIRATE_MAP_HUD"); else --[[ignore this message]] end
